mechanism_narrative: The level of the federal funds rate has a negative linear relationship with S&P 500 forward returns; higher rates compress equity valuations and increase risk aversion, leading to negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and 20-day returns are positive in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 305.0 signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 305.0 and 20-day returns are positive in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.0% and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, it signals an impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.0 AND INDPRO < 100.0 and 20-day returns are positive in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, defined by strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 20000.0) and high industrial production (INDPRO > 105.0), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns due to overvaluation and risk-off sentiment over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 > 20000.0 AND INDPRO > 105.0 and 20-day returns are positive in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100.0 and 20-day returns are positive in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 150000.0 signals weak labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS < 150000.0 and 5-day returns are positive in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) both fall below their respective thresholds (RSAFS < 700000.0 and HOUST < 1500.0), it signals a contraction in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS < 700000.0 AND HOUST < 1500.0 and 60-day returns are positive in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals a tight labor market, which supports strong corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 3.5 and 20-day returns are negative in >50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
